addition.item: A refused workflow transition reports the reason the workflow plugin gave (for example: no cover, no tags).
Site profiles: media/wmarka_mcp/profiles/*.json fill unset settings and add rights on install and update; SiteProfile::applyFolder() for site packages.
House style sample in the package; the journal keeps the versions each call produced, linked to the content history.

change.item: «Do not run on the assistant's changes» is opt-in: empty by default, so the assistant's publications reach the channel through the site's autoposting plugin like anyone's; add system/wmarka_telegram to silence it.

fix.item: joomla_article_update: an edit of the article text was silently lost on Joomla 6 (stored introtext and fulltext overwrote the new text); the answer said "updated: text" while the text in the database stayed unchanged. Now the new text is saved.

joomla_article_update: an edit was refused with "Field required: …" when the article has a required custom field. The current custom field values now travel with every save; values passed by the assistant win.

addition.item: Option «Do not run on the assistant's changes»: listed plugins stay silent when the assistant saves or publishes. Default: Webmarka Telegram autoposting (system/wmarka_telegram), so the assistant's publications are not sent to the channel; editors keep autoposting.

change.item: The update server moved from webmarka.kz to the public repository github.com/bsakhanov/wmarka-updates. Install 1.6.1 manually once; later updates arrive in System → Update.

addition.item: Search fields at once: page_title and meta description are written with every new article; length rules warn, values set by people are kept.
Tag registry: joomla_tags_suggest picks tags for a text in its language; joomla_tag_create proposes a new tag in every site language and creates it after approval.

change.item: One tag switch: tag_create now covers the registry policy of the VRK line; the update carries a stored tag_policy over.

fix.item: Article images are stored with every key of the field, like the Joomla form does: no more PHP warnings in article modules; the update completes articles saved earlier.
Caption format, frame type names and the default house style use the site's default language.
A repeated title gets «-2», «-3» in its alias; a number at the end of the title is no longer changed.

addition.item: Editorial workflow: joomla_workflow_overview, joomla_article_transitions and joomla_article_transition move articles through Joomla workflow stages; each user sees and runs only the transitions of their role («Execute transition» permission).
joomla_article_create accepts a transition to run right after saving; article reading and search show the stage, search filters by stage.
A transition that publishes respects the option «Allow publishing».

change.item: With workflows on, joomla_articles_set_state is hidden and publishing on create is refused: the status follows the stage. Diagnostics no longer warn about workflows and check the publishing workflow plugin instead.

fix.item: Editors without «Edit State» could not edit an article that had a publication date (Joomla rejected the locked field). Locked fields are now left out; a change of them is refused with a clear message.

addition.item: Photo library: four tools — joomla_media_search, joomla_media_get, joomla_media_upload, joomla_media_describe.

Upload by link or base64 the way the article editor does: folder, file name and processing follow Content Image Upload when it is installed; otherwise phone photos are turned by EXIF and lose their metadata (camera, GPS). The same photo is never stored twice.
Register of photos: caption, alt text, credit, source, license, frame type from a closed vocabulary and up to three tags; a credit is required by default.
The assistant sees a preview of the photo before it writes alt text or chooses a frame type.
Photos uploaded in the editor or the media manager are listed as waiting for a description.
Article images: alt text and caption («caption. Photo: credit») come from the library; Joomla's width and height are written with the image.
Links are fetched only over http(s) from public addresses, every redirect checked.

Tag policy: by default the assistant uses existing tags only; an unknown tag is refused with up to five similar existing tags (word order, endings, Kazakh letters, typos). Option «Assistant creates new tags».
Tags that differ only in case, «ё», spacing or punctuation resolve to the existing tag.
AI mark: the server sets a chosen article custom field on every article created through an assistant (optionally also on rewritten ones); the assistant cannot set or clear it.
Diagnostics check for the AI mark field; site_info reports the tag policy and the mark field.

change.item: Behaviour change on update: assistants no longer create tags until the option is turned on.

fix.item: Batch: tags are resolved before anything is moved, so an unknown tag no longer leaves the batch half done.

change.item: The update server moved to webmarka.kz (https://webmarka.kz/updates/com_wmarka_mcp/); the code repository is private.

addition.item: Authors may connect assistants by default; tools and instructions follow the account's Joomla permissions.
Consent screen for authors; site editing links for users without administrator access.
MCP server inside Joomla 6 for both protocol eras (2026-07-28 and 2025-11-25).
OAuth 2.1 sign-in with Joomla accounts: CIMD, DCR, PKCE, refresh token rotation, revocation.
15 tools for articles, categories, tags, versions, cache, page checks and typography; 3 prompts.
Consent screen, administrator overview with diagnostics, connection management.
